applies_why: The judge uses a word-count that cuts both ways as a reason to label the link UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- the sign's chapter bounds (Isaiah 7:16; 8:3-4; 8:8) are real, but C5's own narrowing concedes Matthew 1:23's application stands, and the almah/bethulah word-count cuts both ways (Joel 1:8)
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. -- reading one: a dual-sense verse cannot be treated as open/UNDERDETERMINED; reading two: it only forbids one explicit way of making it open while leaving other grounds available.
why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED label rests partly on the almah/bethulah word-count cutting both ways, which treats the matter as open instead of letting both senses stand.
